result: A center-stable manifold theorem with weakened regularity shows that gradient descent on shallow, scalar-input ReLU and leaky-ReLU networks fitting an affine target avoids most saddle points; whenever its limit loss is below an explicit threshold, it has reached a global minimum.
result_plain: GD on shallow scalar-input (leaky) ReLU nets with affine targets avoids most saddles; below an explicit loss threshold it reaches a global minimum.
